messages:
maria (People Ops): hey all 0303 quick follow-up from the all-hands about the reorg + hiring priorities. keeping answers short here. drop q's and we'll respond.
kevin (CEO): tl;dr: we double-down on infra, reliability, and platform for private deployments. hiring concentrated there for next 120 days.
tara (Head of Eng): to clarify: nobody should assume immediate role changes. we're mapping responsibilities first, then matching people. mobility is encouraged.
jun (SWE): are we expecting any team merges that impact sprint scopes this quarter? hoping not to get derailed.
tara (Head of Eng): minor scope shuffle only. sprint goals stay; some component owners move teams but handoffs will be staggered.
nana? (typo)
nana (Eng Manager): (emoji) small correction: managers will get a heads-up 2 weeks before any reassignment. we'll avoid surprise shifts.
li (VP Product): product hires prioritized by roadmap-critical items: embeddings infra, latency hotspots, and enterprise feature parity.
sam (Recruiter): process note: prioritized reqs get "fast-track" label. hiring owners, please include 2 concrete success metrics on the req (impact-based).
jun (SWE): can contractors be used to staff quick experiments while we hire?
tara (Head of Eng): yes for experiments <3 months. for long-lived ownership we prefer full-time.
kevin (CEO): budget note: we've moved headcount from non-core initiatives into platform. expect approvals for infra roles to be quick.
maria (People Ops): publishing the detailed headcount plan tomorrow in the #all-hands-notes channel. preview: 
```
Q1: net +10 (infra: 5, runtime: 3, reliability:2)
Q2: net +14 (platform:6, enterprise:5, research:3)
Backfills & role moves: ~8
```
nana? (typo)
nana (Eng Manager): any guidance for managers who want to hire ICs vs managers?
kevin (CEO): prefer senior ICs unless a manager role unlocks >2 squads or compliance work.
sam (Recruiter): timeline: approved fast-track reqs -> post in 3 business days, normal reqs -> 10 business days.
jun (SWE): will we have a public mapping doc so ppl can see where they land?
maria (People Ops): yes 10 we0202'll publish a mapping with flags: "retained", "open" or "under-review". there will be a 2-week internal mobility window after publication.
ops-bot: Reminder: all hiring reqs must use the new template by EOD Friday.
kevin (CEO): final note: this shift is about reliability and keeping SLAs. expect more hiring energy next month. thanks for the thoughtful qs.
maria (People Ops): we'll turn this thread into an FAQ and pin it. DM me for private follow-ups. :raised_hands:
